title: BPP placement_admit request (DESIGN.md §11.1, §11.4; registry R33 runtime)
description: Mutation (meta required, create-classed). Stage 4 of the §11.1 activation: the narrow Kovee placement adapter bound to the exact ResourceAllocation, pinned through the portable_public binding digest `episode_request` published. Byom records only a PlacementAdmission after source verification — Kovee alone authors the PlacementBinding. The request also carries the `byom_subordinate` saga outcome, because §14.6 defines no byom-side catalog operation for the Kovee-owned saga verbs (recorded deviation): a confirmed outcome completes the reservation set and queues the Episode, a denial releases only demonstrably unspent byom quantity, and an unknown result stays uncertain with spend blocked until the R38 seat decides.

resource_allocation_digest.description: The PUBLISHED cross-boundary binding digest of the exact ResourceAllocation — byte-identical to the resource_allocation_digest `episode_request` returned for this allocation. It is portable_public over the `bpp-resource-allocation-binding-v0` fragment, so Kovee derives and pins the same value byom compares; byom's own keyed record digest is never asked for (seam findings S-1/S-2).

stable_external_reservation_key.description: The kernel-derived stable key the bridge persisted before queueing (§11.4); Kovee can only echo it.

outcome.description: The §11.4 saga outcome: Kovee may narrow or deny but never parallel-charge; an unknown result stays uncertain and spend stays blocked (family contract L33).

amount.description: Reserved amount; MUST be <= parent_worst_case_amount — never above parent (§11.4, family contract L32). JSON Schema cannot compare two members; byomd enforces it as a cross-member check.

items.description: Per-dimension items, each pinned to its exact parent §11.4 reservation item.

subordinate_reservation.description: The `byom_subordinate` reservation outcome the narrow Kovee placement adapter reports; the confirmed arm alone names a committed ref/revision/digest and items (all-or-none).

oneOf.$comment: Kovee durably committed the reservation: its exact ref, revision, digest and at least one item are required (§11.4).
A denial or unknown result created nothing, so it names no ref/revision/digest and no items.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset, semantically valid in the proleptic Gregorian calendar: the pattern pins the lexical ranges and implementations MUST additionally reject impossible calendar instants (e.g. 2026-02-30) — the conformance runner enforces this on every vector; leap seconds are not accepted. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3, amended per RT-17).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.

mutationMeta.description: MutationMeta (§14.2), create-classed: this operation creates a record (or CASes a subordinate head through its own body fields), so the closed create meta carries NO expected_revision member — supplying one fails the closed schema (RT-01: update CAS is structural, never optional).

portablePublicDigest.description: Contextual digest-class binding (PROFILE.md §6.2, D-R0-1; RT-02): this field commits to a PORTABLE structure a peer re-derives without a byom secret, so exactly class portable_public (unkeyed SHA-256) is acceptable. A well-constructed digest of any other class here is digest_class_mismatch — never a silent substitution.
